mapper.select: SELECT R.ROOM_SN, R.HOUSE_SN, R.ROOM_NM, R.ROOM_STTS_CD, R.BSC_PRSN_CNT, R.MAX_PRSN_CNT, R.DFLT_STOCK_QTY, R.MIN_STAY_NGT_CNT, R.ROOM_DC, R.AREA_SQM, R.ROOM_CNT, R.BATHRM_CNT, R.REG_DT, R.MDFCN_DT, H.PRTNR_SN AS OWNER_PRTNR_SN FROM ROOM R JOIN HOUSE H ON H.HOUSE_SN = R.HOUSE_SN AND H.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE R.ROOM_SN = #{roomSn} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT HOUSE_SN FROM ROOM WHERE ROOM_SN = #{roomSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT ROOM_SN, HOUSE_SN, ROOM_STTS_CD, DEL_YN FROM ROOM WHERE ROOM_SN = #{roomSn} FOR UPDATE

SELECT R.ROOM_SN, R.HOUSE_SN, R.ROOM_NM, R.ROOM_STTS_CD, R.BSC_PRSN_CNT, R.MAX_PRSN_CNT, R.DFLT_STOCK_QTY, R.MIN_STAY_NGT_CNT, R.ROOM_DC, R.AREA_SQM, R.ROOM_CNT, R.BATHRM_CNT, R.REG_DT, R.MDFCN_DT FROM ROOM R WHERE R.HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY R.ROOM_SN DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ROOM R JOIN HOUSE H ON H.HOUSE_SN = R.HOUSE_SN AND H.PRTNR_SN = #{prtnrSn} AND H.DEL_YN = 'N' SET R.ROOM_NM = #{roomNm}, R.BSC_PRSN_CNT = #{bscPrsnCnt}, R.MAX_PRSN_CNT = #{maxPrsnCnt}, R.DFLT_STOCK_QTY = #{dfltStockQty}, R.MIN_STAY_NGT_CNT = #{minStayNgtCnt}, R.ROOM_DC = #{roomDc}, R.AREA_SQM = #{areaSqm}, R.ROOM_CNT = #{roomCnt}, R.BATHRM_CNT = #{bathrmCnt}, R.MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), R.MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE R.ROOM_SN = #{roomSn} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N'

UPDATE ROOM R JOIN HOUSE H ON H.HOUSE_SN = R.HOUSE_SN AND H.PRTNR_SN = #{prtnrSn} AND H.DEL_YN = 'N' SET R.ROOM_STTS_CD = #{roomSttsCd}, R.MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), R.MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE R.ROOM_SN = #{roomSn} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND R.ROOM_STTS_CD <> 'SUSPENDED'

UPDATE ROOM R JOIN HOUSE H ON H.HOUSE_SN = R.HOUSE_SN AND H.PRTNR_SN = #{prtnrSn} AND H.DEL_YN = 'N' SET R.DEL_YN = 'Y', R.MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), R.MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE R.ROOM_SN = #{roomSn} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N'

UPDATE ROOM R JOIN HOUSE H ON H.HOUSE_SN = R.HOUSE_SN AND H.PRTNR_SN = #{prtnrSn} AND H.DEL_YN = 'N' SET R.DEL_YN = 'Y', R.MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), R.MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE R.HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N'
